resources.peak_host_memory_basis: Maximum ru_maxrss*1024 across experiment execution processes, not aggregate of overlapping processes
resources.wall_start_basis: Conservative pre-dispatch bound: contract freeze mtime provided by master; includes implementation time.
resources.cpu_time_scope: Main generation, replay, and post-integrity processes; short preparation, manual review, and report scripts excluded from process CPU sum but included in elapsed budget.

key_findings: Raw transfer remained confined to the selected square within numerical precision: maximum outside-mask complex error 4.5475e-13; imaginary residual 4.9927e-16. Clipping introduced outside-mask changes, supporting the mechanism hypothesis.
At radius 4, alpha 1, median post-clipping outside-mask relative L2 was 0.20273 intra and 0.24423 inter; p95 was 0.54227 and 0.53781. Relative raw changes stayed below 4.50e-15 across the grid.
Full-strength median RGB RMS increased from r0 to r4: 0.18981 to 0.23758 intra, 0.23086 to 0.27388 inter. Inter exceeded intra in every matched condition, descriptively for these fixed donors.

Visual inspection showed mostly retained layouts with stronger color patches/halos and altered surface markings at larger radii/strengths. Representative identity retained/uncertain: intra 179/13, inter 176/16; anatomy/markings disrupted: intra 15/192, inter 33/192. These are unblinded correlated judgments, not accuracy estimates.

Clipping-ranked intra tails were visually mild on white backgrounds despite 61.8-66.0% clipped channels (RMS 0.00586-0.03819, maximum excursions 0.0131-0.0827). Inter tails mixed mild recoloring, darkening, and strong cyan contamination. None of the selected excursions was roundoff-sized.
limitations: A1-only 604-image fixed cohort and one frozen donor pairing per arm; no A2/B analysis.
No training, discriminator, classifier, pretrained features, augmentation-utility, class-correctness, or FID measurement; no recipe selected.

Visual judgments are unblinded AI comparisons at 64 pixels, limited to 16 representative contents and eight ranked outputs. Repeated conditions are correlated; dense/washed-out source details are sometimes uncertain.
Background-contamination labels include visible color changes to the background, not evidence of copied donor objects. Anatomy/markings includes surface coloration.
Global donor image amplitude includes subject and background; donor-class differences do not isolate a causal class effect.
Clipped fraction is a strict scalar-channel count and is not perceptual severity; tail selection is biased toward clipping, including white-background DC cases.
Raw metrics use unnormalized NumPy complex FFT norms. Relative L2 denominators depend on source and radius; exact-zero flags are explicit.
Elapsed budget uses the master-provided conservative pre-dispatch contract-freeze timestamp; host memory is measured process peak.

evidence_notes.sheet_count: 32 representative arm-specific sheets plus 2 sheets containing four separately labeled tails each.
evidence_notes.failures: One bare-python inspection command unavailable; no numerical/generation failure occurred. Saved evidence documents resolution.
